meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: component_aVXwLZNBz36Tlw3nw_playbook
actions:
  Create_Enrichment_Variables:
    title: Create Enrichment Variables
    type: createVariables
    description: Define Enrichment Provider and Enrichment Response Array
    on-success:
    - Map_Observable_Metadata_to_Value: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
    - name: Enrichment_Provider
      value: URLScan
    - name: Enrichment
      value: []
    - name: observable_value
      value: '{ $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_value }'
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    inputSchemaReferenceId: c2e04074-32f8-4b6a-9b89-a4463523d61a
    outputSchemaReferenceId: 2f11b012-ddad-47f3-8785-6101731ecebb
  Conditional_Parallel:
    title: Conditional Parallel
    type: parallelGroup
    description: Handle various conditionals
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete:
    - NOOP: {}
    publish: {}
    entrypoints:
    - IPURLDomainHash
    actions:
      IPURLDomainHash:
        title: If URL/Domain
        type: conditional
        description: If the observable is a supported type
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        conditions:
        - action: Submit_Observable
          condition:
            $:or:
            - - $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_type
              - $:eq: domain
              - ignoreCase: true
            - - $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_type
              - $:eq: url
              - ignoreCase: true
        else: ""
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 3e39004e-76dd-42af-88da-970099211b8e
      Create_TEDS_Enrichment:
        title: Create TEDS Enrichment
        type: transformation
        description: Create a TEDS enrichment based on the retrieved reputation information
        on-success:
        - Update_Enrichment_Reputation: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        transformations:
          enrichment_verdict:
            title: Enrichment Verdict
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: >-
                (
                    $maxScore := $max(actions.get_observable_reputation.result.json_body.verdicts.*.score);
                    $type($maxScore) != "number" ? "Unknown" :
                    $maxScore < 10 ? "Benign" :
                    $maxScore < 50 ? "Suspicious" :
                    $maxScore <= 100 ? "Malicious" :
                    "unknown"
                )
              data:
                actions:
                  get_observable_reputation:
                    result:
                      json_body:
                        verdicts:
                          $:ref: $actions.get_observable_reputation.result.json_body.verdicts
            actionType: jsonata
            next: enrichment_timestamp
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
            testInputs:
              data: {}
              expression: ""
          enrichment_timestamp:
            title: Enrichment Timestamp
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: $now()
              data: {}
            actionType: jsonata
            next: enrichment_permalink
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
            testInputs:
              data: {}
              expression: ""
          enrichment_permalink:
            title: Enrichment Permalink
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: actions.get_observable_reputation.result.json_body.task.reportURL
              data:
                inputs:
                  observable:
                    observable_value:
                      $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_value
                actions:
                  getResult_as91z:
                    result:
                      json_body:
                        task:
                          reportURL:
                            $:ref: $actions.get_observable_reputation.result.json_body.task.reportURL
                  get_observable_reputation:
                    result:
                      json_body:
                        task:
                          reportURL:
                            $:ref: $actions.get_observable_reputation.result.json_body.task.reportURL
            actionType: jsonata
            next: enrichment_context
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
            testInputs:
              data: {}
              expression: ""
          enrichment_context:
            title: Enrichment Context
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: >-
                (
                    $data := actions.get_observable_reputation.result.json_body.verdicts;

                    /* 1. Extract specifically the engines score */
                    $engineScore := $data.engines.score;

                    /* 2. Apply the threshold logic only to the engines score */
                    $verdictName := $type($engineScore) != "number" ? "Unknown" :
                                    $engineScore < 10 ? "Benign" :
                                    $engineScore < 50 ? "Suspicious" :
                                    $engineScore <= 100 ? "Malicious" : 
                                    "Unknown";

                    /* 3. Safely extract and format categories */
                    $categories := $count($data.engines.categories) > 0 ? $join($data.engines.categories, ", ") : "unknown";

                    /* 4. Build the final string */
                    $context := $data.engines ? 
                        "Malicious: " & ($data.engines.maliciousTotal ? $data.engines.maliciousTotal : 0) & 
                        ", Benign: " & ($data.engines.benignTotal ? $data.engines.benignTotal : 0) & 
                        ", Categories: " & $categories & 
                        ", Verdict: " & $verdictName
                        : "No Context Provided"
                )
              data:
                actions:
                  get_observable_reputation:
                    result:
                      json_body:
                        verdicts:
                          $:ref: $actions.get_observable_reputation.result.json_body.verdicts
            actionType: jsonata
            next: enrichment
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
            testInputs:
              data: {}
              expression: ""
          enrichment:
            title: Enrichment
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: >-
                {
                    "enrichment_type": "reputation",
                    "enrichment_provider": variables.Enrichment_Provider,
                    "enrichment_verdict": actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_verdict,
                    "enrichment_timestamp": actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_timestamp,
                    "enrichment_permalink": actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_permalink,
                    "enrichment_context": actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_context,
                    "enrichment_raw_data": actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.trimmed_enrichment_data
                }
              data:
                variables:
                  Enrichment_Provider:
                    $:ref: $variables.Enrichment_Provider
                actions:
                  Create_TEDS_Enrichment:
                    result:
                      enrichment_verdict:
                        $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_verdict
                      enrichment_timestamp:
                        $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_timestamp
                      enrichment_permalink:
                        $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_permalink
                      enrichment_context:
                        $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_context
                      trimmed_enrichment_data:
                        $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.trimmed_enrichment_data
                  getResult_as91z:
                    result:
                      json_body:
                        $:ref: $actions.get_observable_reputation.result.json_body
                  get_observable_reputation:
                    result:
                      json_body:
                        $:ref: $actions.get_observable_reputation.result.json_body
            actionType: jsonata
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
            next: ""
            testInputs:
              data: {}
              expression: ""
          trimmed_enrichment_data:
            title: Trimmed Enrichment Data
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: >-
                (
                    $jb := actions.get_observable_reputation.result.json_body;
                    $t := actions.get_observable_reputation.result.json_body.task;
                    $v := actions.get_observable_reputation.result.json_body.verdicts;
                    $e := actions.get_observable_reputation.result.json_body.verdicts.engines;
                    $us := actions.get_observable_reputation.result.json_body.verdicts.urlscan;

                    {
                        "task": {
                            "reportURL": $t.reportURL,
                            "uuid": $t.uuid,
                            "url": $t.url,
                            "time": $t.time
                        },
                        "verdicts": {
                            "urlscan": {
                                "score": $us.score,
                                "categories": $us.categories,
                                "malicious": $us.malicious
                            },
                            "engines": {
                                "maliciousTotal": $e.maliciousTotal,
                                "benignTotal": $e.benignTotal
                            }
                        }
                    }
                )
              data:
                actions:
                  get_observable_reputation:
                    result:
                      json_body:
                        data:
                          $:ref: $actions.get_observable_reputation.result.json_body.data
                        task:
                          $:ref: $actions.get_observable_reputation.result.json_body.task
                        verdicts:
                          $:ref: $actions.get_observable_reputation.result.json_body.verdicts
            actionType: jsonata
            next: enrichment_verdict
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
            testInputs:
              data: {}
              expression: ""
        entrypoint: trimmed_enrichment_data
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 54bf20b0-8587-4da3-90fb-99b607c44c86
        errorSchemaReferenceId: eba2c7b6-3d9e-4bfa-8253-a74f95aaaeef
      Update_Enrichment_Reputation:
        title: Update Enrichment (Reputation)
        type: updateVariables
        description: ""
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        inputs:
        - name: Enrichment
          operation:
            type: set
            value:
              $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 33d2670f-8390-413e-8f6e-8f073ae9d234
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
      Submit_Observable:
        meta: {}
        title: Submit Observable
        type: connector
        delay: 0
        pool: $default
        on-success:
        - get_observable_reputation: {}
        on-failure:
        - Create_TEDS_Error_Enrichment_Error: {}
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: ""
        action: urlscan.submit
        asset: URLScan
        environment: {}
        inputs:
          json_body:
            url: '{ $:ref: $variables.observable_value }'
            visibility: private
          verify_ssl: true
        testInputs:
          json_body:
            visibility: public
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 1f0c9f82-864c-4025-a0ae-3064d59b558f
      get_observable_reputation:
        meta: {}
        title: Get Observable Reputation
        type: connector
        delay: 0
        pool: $default
        on-success:
        - Create_TEDS_Enrichment: {}
        on-failure:
        - Create_TEDS_Error_Enrichment_Error_Get_Reputation: {}
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: Retrieve reputation information from URLScan
        retryUntil:
          delay: 5000
          duration: 900000
          if:
            $:and:
            - - $:ref: $actions.get_observable_reputation.result.status_code
              - $:eq: 200
          limit: 3
        action: urlscan.get_result
        asset: URLScan
        environment: {}
        inputs:
          path_parameters:
            uuid: '{ $:ref: $actions.Submit_Observable.result.json_body.uuid }'
          verify_ssl: true
        testInputs: {}
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 52dbe5e5-0d7a-4d53-8c64-a966603c4438
      Update_Enrichment_Error_Reputation_a004n:
        meta: {}
        title: 'Update Enrichment (Error: Reputation)'
        type: updateVariables
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: ""
        inputSchemaReferenceId: axgdr
        inputs:
        - name: Enrichment
          operation:
            type: set
            value:
              $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Error_Enrichment_Error.result.published.enrichment
        outputSchemaReferenceId: 0c1ad9e1-07f0-44e6-95ae-ee4f60a70257
      Create_TEDS_Error_Enrichment_Error:
        meta: {}
        title: Create TEDS Error Enrichment
        type: connector
        delay: 0
        pool: $default
        on-success:
        - Update_Enrichment_Error_Reputation_a004n: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: ""
        inputSchemaReferenceId: al2i6
        action: $playbook.component_aT0MBgT0PDhSCQjJu_playbook
        asset: ""
        environment: {}
        inputs:
          error_provider: URLScan
          error_result: Error occurred while submitting observable to URLScan
          error_status: '{ $:ref: $actions.Submit_Observable.result.status_code }'
        testInputs: {}
      Update_Enrichment_Error_Reputation_azlr9:
        meta: {}
        title: 'Update Enrichment (Error: Reputation)'
        type: updateVariables
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: ""
        inputSchemaReferenceId: aeioi
        outputSchemaReferenceId: a2qc4
        inputs:
        - name: Enrichment
          operation:
            type: set
            value:
              $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Error_Enrichment_Error_Get_Reputation.result.published.enrichment
      Create_TEDS_Error_Enrichment_Error_Get_Reputation:
        meta: {}
        title: Create TEDS Error Enrichment
        type: connector
        delay: 0
        pool: $default
        on-success:
        - Update_Enrichment_Error_Reputation_azlr9: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        description: ""
        inputSchemaReferenceId: aji8n
        action: $playbook.component_aT0MBgT0PDhSCQjJu_playbook
        asset: ""
        environment: {}
        inputs:
          error_provider: URLScan
          error_result: Error occurred while getting observable reputation from URLScan
          error_status: '{ $:ref: $actions.get_observable_reputation.result.status_code }'
        testInputs: {}
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  NOOP:
    title: NOOP
    type: transformation
    description: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    transformations: {}
    entrypoint: ""
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Map_Observable_Metadata_to_Value:
    meta: {}
    title: Map Obsrvable Metadata to Value
    type: connector
    delay: 0
    pool: $default
    on-success:
    - Make_URL: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: ""
    action: $playbook.component_aVDzhxtQHCIz46uEg_playbook
    asset: ""
    environment: {}
    inputs:
      observable:
        $:ref: $inputs.observable
    testInputs: {}
  updateVariables_agdvf:
    title: Update Observable Value
    type: updateVariables
    description: ""
    on-success:
    - Conditional_Parallel: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
    - name: observable_value
      operation:
        type: set
        value: '{ $:ref: $actions.Make_URL.result.make_url }'
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 6370a488-6e2e-436d-bd44-7ce167463042
    outputSchemaReferenceId: d458e2ad-e0a7-45f1-8b84-1dbed1c3f2a3
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""

    timeout: 0
  Make_URL:
    meta: {}
    title: Make URL
    type: transformation
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success:
    - updateVariables_agdvf: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: ""
    inputSchemaReferenceId: ajee9
    outputSchemaReferenceId: atmuo
    transformations:
      make_url:
        title: Make URL
        inputs:
          data:
            inputs:
              observable:
                observable_type:
                  $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_type
                observable_value:
                  $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_value
          expression: "(\n  $value := inputs.observable.observable_value;\n  $type := inputs.observable.observable_type;\n  \n  $lowercase($type) = \"domain\" \n    ? \"https://\" & $value \n    : $value\n)"
        next: ""
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
        actionType: jsonata
        testInputs:
          data: {}
          expression: ""
    entrypoint: make_url
    errorSchemaReferenceId: 41fea256-9af3-4697-aff8-13f590cb9762
